description: BTR Airport Signatory Airlines Passenger Stats is a dataset listed in City of Baton Rouge open data portal (data.brla.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Baton Rouge. This dataset provides the monthly enplanement and deplanement statistics since 1986 for all signatory airlines flying to and from the Baton Rouge Metropolitan Airport. Coverage: Baton Rouge. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Infrastructure. Its tags are enplanement, btr, airline, transportation, passenger. The table has 19 columns. Attribution on the portal: Baton Rouge Metropolitan Airport. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-brla-gov-portal.
